tool_args.rationale: Across five paid rows spanning u_now=0.6–3.7 and H≈3.6–4.2, y/u_now remains approximately 2.11 despite varied x_now and mem_conv. A numerically fitted affine-in-u model is the parsimonious candidate; available probes do not address the remaining low-value alternatives.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Not present in the available probe cost menu; observed outputs track u_now nearly linearly across the available H range.
The observations show no residual dependence on x_now, mem_conv, or H warranting the costly coupled-memory ODE probe.

considered_alternatives.option: dual-horizon adaptation or coupled memory ODE
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Current outputs align closely with a static linear response; H, x_now, and mem_conv vary without an observable effect, and no evidence indicates a horizon reversal.
Irrelevant to identifying the stable near-linear relationship and explicitly disallowed as a wasteful probe.
